name: implement a row-parallel linear layer that shards weights and all-reduces partial sums
definition: Split the weight matrix along the input dimension across ranks and sum per-rank partial outputs via an all-reduce-equivalent, with full bias retained on every rank.
failure_mode: Incorrect row partitioning or missing reduction yields wrong output

name: implement adaptive rejection sampling in r
definition: write an adaptive-rejection sampler that accepts an unnormalized log-concave density, a domain, and a sample count, returning samples that reproduce the target distribution surface.
failure_mode: wrong distribution shape (e.g. near-uniform outputs) fails the mean/std check
